title: Lizzie Healy
text:
About


I earned a Master of Science in Data Science and Analytics from Georgetown University, after a B.A. in Quantitative Economics with a minor in Applied Mathematics from Haverford College.
My work sits where economics meets machine learning: causal questions about film and labor markets, route optimization to cut delivery emissions, and large-scale text analysis of how cities talk online.
Browse my projects below, and feel free to reach out.

title: About this site
text:
About this site

Built with: Quarto, with custom HTML, CSS and JavaScript, hosted on GitHub Pages. The source is on GitHub.
Built with AI: I designed and coded the site with help from Claude, Anthropic’s AI assistant. Claude helped with the layout, the design prototype, the code, and first drafts of the project summaries.
My part: All the projects are my own work. I chose the structure and design, reviewed every change, and edited all of the text.
I work on bringing AI into business intelligence workflows, so building this site with an AI collaborator was a deliberate choice: it’s how I like to work.
